mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_effect_order(tenant_id,order_id,store_id,series_id,campaign_id,campaign_version,ordered_at,paid,paid_amount,refunded,discount_amount,platform_funding,merchant_funding) VALUES(#{tenant},#{input.orderId},#{input.storeId},#{input.seriesId},#{input.campaignId},#{input.campaignVersion},#{input.orderedAt},#{input.paid},#{input.paidAmount},#{input.refunded},#{input.discountAmount},#{input.platformFunding},#{input.merchantFunding}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE paid=GREATEST(paid,#{input.paid}),refunded=GREATEST(refunded,#{input.refunded}),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
